argv: for s in absent dup noop mixed; do bash tools/mutate-and-run.sh --target "$1/s/gate.sh" --defects "$1/s/$s.spec" --suite 'touch "$WORKDIR/suite-ran.$DEFECT_ID"; bash "$MUTANT" --selftest' --workdir "$1/s/refuse-$s" >"$1/s/refuse-$s.log" 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E "^(APPLY FAIL|spec:|MUTATE: SETUP|MUTATE: (DONE|DEGRADED))" "$1/s/refuse-$s.log"; printf "[%s] exit=%s markers=%s headline=%s\n" "$s" "$rc" "$(find "$1/s/refuse-$s" -name 'suite-ran.*' | wc -l)" "$(grep -cE '^MUTATE: (DONE|DEGRADED)' "$1/s/refuse-$s.log")"; done; bash tools/mutate-and-run.sh --target "$1/s/gate.sh" --defects "$1/s/done.spec" --suite 'touch "$WORKDIR/suite-ran.$DEFECT_ID"; bash "$MUTANT" --selftest; exit 5' --workdir "$1/s/red" >"$1/s/red.log" 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E "^(CONTROL:|MUTATE: SETUP|MUTATE: (DONE|DEGRADED))" "$1/s/red.log"; echo "[red] exit=$rc markers=$(find "$1/s/red" -name 'suite-ran.*' | wc -l) mutant-outs=$(find "$1/s/red/evidence" -type f ! -name control.out | wc -l)"; cp -p "$1/s/gate.sh" "$1/s/alias/defects.tsv"; bash tools/mutate-and-run.sh --target "$1/s/alias/defects.tsv" --defects "$1/s/done.spec" --suite 'bash "$MUTANT" --selftest' --workdir "$1/s/alias" >"$1/s/alias.log" 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E "^(MUTATE_RESTORE:|MUTATE: SETUP|MUTATE: (DONE|DEGRADED))" "$1/s/alias.log"; echo "[alias] exit=$rc original-hash=$(sha256sum "$1/s/alias/defects.tsv" | cut -c1-16) pristine-hash=$(sha256sum "$1/s/alias/pristine.defects.tsv" | cut -c1-16)"
